rect.chaseClears: On {cols}×{rows}, chasing clears the whole board.
rect.straightAbove: Each lit bottom light: tap the top light straight above it.
rect.threeAbove: Each lit bottom light: tap the three top lights above it. Overlaps cancel.
rect.twoAside: Each lit bottom light: tap the top lights two places left and right; at the edges, also the one above.
rect.aboveTwoAside: Each lit bottom light: tap the top light above it and two places left and right; at the edges, skip that one.
rect.ownTaps: Each lit bottom light has its own top lights to tap. Overlaps cancel.

shapes.title: One tap, five lights
shapes.summary: Spot a tap's shape, tap its centre.
steps: A tap flips the light you touch and the four around it: a plus of five.
At an edge it's a T; in a corner, an L.
See one of these shapes? Tap its centre and it goes dark.
Your turn: each board needs one tap. Find the centre.

order.title: Order doesn't matter
steps: Tap a light twice and nothing changes: the second tap undoes the first.
So an answer is just which lights to tap. Tap each once, in any order.
Your turn: spot the shapes. Each board takes two or three taps.

chase.title: Chase the lights down
chase.summary: Push the lights down to the bottom.
steps: Tap right under a lit light and it goes dark. Do that for every lit light in the top row.
Do the same for each row below. The lights move down: this is chasing.
Sometimes lights are left in the bottom row. The next lesson clears them.
Your turn: chase from the top. Stuck? Assist rings the next tap.

bottom-row.title: Clear the bottom row
steps: Tap one top light on a dark board, then chase. The row left at the bottom is its echo.
A chase left B's echo? Tap B, then chase again: they cancel.
Every row a chase can leave is on this list. Find yours, tap the top lights it shows, chase again.
Your turn: chase, tap the top lights for your row, chase again.

shortest.title: The shortest answer
steps: Par is the fewest taps that solve a board. Chasing always works, but often takes more.
Your turn. Any solve counts; hitting par earns three stars in levels.

echo-more.title: Echoes, deeper
echo-more.summary: Rules, stacked echoes, how an echo forms, a drill.
steps: Five rules cover every bottom row.
Some rows are two echoes. Tap both top lights: where they overlap, they cancel.
Pick a light and follow its taps down, row by row. The last row is its echo.
Whose echo is this? Tap the top lights that clear it.

shortest-more.title: Several answers
steps: Tap all the marked lights and nothing changes. Add them to an answer and you get another answer.

echo.caption: {name}'s echo. Tap a letter to try another.

rules.three: Three in a row: tap above the middle one.
rules.allButMiddle: All but the middle: tap the top middle.
rules.pairLoner: A pair and a loner: tap the top corner over the dark end.
rules.corners: Both corners: tap a top corner and its neighbour.
rules.gap: Two with a gap: tap above one, plus the far corner on the other side.
rules.mirror: Each rule works mirrored, left for right.

drill.scoreLine: Rows you missed come back sooner.

learn.echoMatch: That's {name}'s echo: tap {name}, then chase again.

lights.end: All dark. Tap a letter to try another.

5x6.summary: Chase, then the top light above.
steps: Chase down: tap under each lit light, row by row. What's left ends up in the bottom row.
Each bottom light: tap the top light straight above it, then chase again.
Several bottom lights: tap above each one, then chase again.
Your turn: chase, tap the top lights, chase again. Stuck? Assist rings the next tap.

6x6.summary: Chase, then two places left and right.
steps: Chase down: tap under each lit light, row by row. What's left ends up in the bottom row.
Each bottom light: tap the top lights two places left and right of it. At A and F, also tap the one above.
Several bottom lights: tap the top lights for each one, then chase again. A light tapped twice cancels.
Your turn: chase, tap the top lights, chase again. Stuck? Assist rings the next tap.

7x7.summary: Chase, then three top lights above.
steps: Chase down: tap under each lit light, row by row. What's left ends up in the bottom row.
Each bottom light: tap the three top lights above it (two at an edge), then chase again.
Several bottom lights: tap the top lights for each one, then chase again. A light tapped twice cancels.
Your turn: chase, tap the top lights, chase again. Stuck? Assist rings the next tap.

8x8.summary: Chase, then each light's top lights.
steps: Chase down: tap under each lit light, row by row. What's left ends up in the bottom row.
Each bottom light has its own top lights to tap. H is A flipped left to right, G is B, and so on.
Several bottom lights: tap the top lights for each one, then chase again. A light tapped twice cancels.
Your turn: chase, tap the top lights, chase again. Stuck? Assist rings the next tap.

10x10.summary: Chase, then above + two places aside.
steps: Chase down: tap under each lit light, row by row. What's left ends up in the bottom row.
Each bottom light: tap the top light above it and the ones two places left and right. At A and J, skip the one above.
Several bottom lights: tap the top lights for each one, then chase again. A light tapped twice cancels.
Your turn: chase, tap the top lights, chase again. Stuck? Assist rings the next tap.

tower.summary: Chase all the way, then tap above.
steps: Chase down: tap under each lit light, all the way down. What's left ends up in the bottom row.
Each bottom light: tap the top light straight above it, then chase again.
Several bottom lights: tap above each one, then chase again.
Your turn: scroll as you chase. Stuck? Assist rings the next tap.

cross.summary: Spot whole shapes, or chase and fix.
steps: A tap flips a plus. This board's edges cut it short: a T or an L.
Spot whole shapes and tap their centres, corners first.
Stuck? Chase down: tap under each lit light, row by row.
Then tap the top-edge light shown and chase again. Top-edge lights have nothing above them.
Your turn: spot shapes, or chase. In levels, the book button shows the top-edge light.

ring.summary: Spot whole shapes, or chase and fix.
steps: A tap flips a plus. The edges and the hole cut it short: a T or an L.
Spot whole shapes and tap their centres, corners first.
Stuck? Chase down: tap under each lit light, row by row.
Then tap the top-edge light shown and chase again. Top-edge lights have nothing above them.
Your turn: spot shapes, or chase. In levels, the book button shows the top-edge light.

diamond.summary: Spot whole shapes, or chase and fix.
steps: A tap flips a plus. The edges cut it short: an L, or a pair at the tips.
Spot whole shapes and tap their centres, tips first.
Stuck? Chase down: tap under each lit light, row by row.
Then tap the top-edge light shown and chase again. Top-edge lights have nothing above them.
Your turn: spot shapes, or chase. In levels, the book button shows the top-edge light.
